notes.title: Demo Updated!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hi Dread Protocol fans![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Whilst I’ve been hard at work finishing the full game, many of those improvements have made their way into the demo, so it was time for an update![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Demo Updates:[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]20 New Star Map Encounters[/b][/p][p]Fresh choices and outcomes to discover... and these are just the ones added to the demo![/p][p][/p][p][b]More enemies per station[/b][/p][p]I want Dread Protocol to feel punishing. By upping the number of enemies you face per station, the action and intensity stay high. [/p][p][/p][p][b]New Grading System[/b][/p][p]Get scored at the end of each stage and see how well you performed. Score is heavily tied to combos and kills, you'll need to chain frags together to get S Tier. [/p][p]
[b]Fight Friendlies at the Homebase[/b][/p][p][i]“Are you ok chief? Why you lookin’ at me like that?”[/i][/p][p]Run cut short? Why not take it out on your comrades?

[b]More Destructibles[/b][/p][p]Even more walls, crates, and cover objects can now be blown apart.[/p][p]
+ lots of quality of life improvements[/p][h3]

Check it out, give me feedback, I hope you all enjoy! 

[b]James[/b][/h3]
